answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 5211 Country: India Title: I saw a dream that i was climbing my grand mas home to up stairs with a huge mango, there i saw a monkey sitting on the upstairs and it frightened e then i gave my mango to it and then the monkey started with bismillah and started reciting the quran. whats all these mean? Question: assalamualikum, I saw a dream that i was climbing my grand mas home to up stairs with a huge mango, there i saw a monkey sitting on the upstairs and it frightened e then i gave my mango to it and then the monkey started with bismillah and started reciting the quran. whats all these mean? Answer ID: 5211 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1111/836=H/1429) You are slacking in fulfilling the rights pertaining to Allah and His creature. In the dream, your attention was diverted specially to the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
